title: Add a simple site-wide search bar for updates/posts

requirements.text: Add a new Search page route that lets students search across all seeded updates (all categories) and view matching results using the existing UpdateCard layout.

quotes: would you like to add a simple search bar so students can find updates faster?

acceptanceCriteria: A new route exists (e.g., /search) and renders inside the existing SiteLayout.
The Search page includes a search input with a clear label/placeholder in English (e.g., "Search updates...").
Typing a query filters across all available updates from the existing seed data (at minimum: title + excerpt; body matching is optional but if implemented must not break performance).
Results are shown as a responsive grid/list of existing UpdateCard components, and clicking a card navigates to the existing /post/$postId detail page.
When the query is empty, the page shows a helpful empty state (e.g., instructions or popular/latest items) instead of a blank list.
When there are zero matches, the page shows a clear “No results found” state with a suggestion to try different keywords.
The page sets appropriate SEO title and meta description via the existing usePageMeta hook.

requirements.text: Add a simple search bar entry point in the site header for both desktop and mobile that navigates to the Search page and pre-fills the query using a URL query parameter (e.g., /search?q=...).

quotes: add a simple search bar so students can find updates faster

acceptanceCriteria: Desktop header provides a visible search control (input or button) without overcrowding the existing navigation links.
Mobile navigation provides a search entry point that is easy to tap and does not reduce menu usability (menu remains scrollable).
Submitting a search from header/mobile navigates to the Search page and includes the query in the URL (e.g., q=term).
The Search page reads the URL query parameter on load and shows the corresponding filtered results.
The search UI is mobile-safe (no overlaps, input/button fits on small screens, appropriate spacing).

requirements.text: Implement lightweight, client-side search logic that is fast for the current dataset and does not add heavy dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Search implementation uses simple string matching and does not introduce heavy third-party search libraries.
Search is case-insensitive and trims extra whitespace in the query.
Search results order is deterministic (e.g., newest first among matches or stable original order) and does not flicker between renders.
No backend changes are required for search; search works offline against the existing seeded content model.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only and must be composed, not modified).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (immutable paths).
Keep the implementation lightweight and fast-loading; avoid heavy libraries for search.
nonGoals: Building a backend-backed full-text search index.
Adding an admin UI to manage content.
Adding user accounts beyond the existing Internet Identity integration.
